question.text: Two spheres of the same material, but of radii $R$ and $3 R$ are allowed to fall vertically downwards through a liquid of density $\rho$. The ratio of their terminal velocities is

solution.text:
The terminal velocity, $v=\frac{2 r^{2}(p-\sigma) g}{9 \eta}$
As, all other parameters are constant, therefore $v\propto r^{2}$
$\Rightarrow \quad \frac{v_{R}}{v_{3 R}}=\frac{(R)^{2}}{(3 R)^{2}}=\frac{1}{9}$
